from pathlib import Path
program = '''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    boxes = []
    for color in sorted({v for row in g for v in row if v != 0}):
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == color]
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells); r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells); c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
            continue
        if (all(g[r0][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and
            all(g[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and
            all(g[r][c0] == color for r in range(r0,r1+1)) and
            all(g[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0,r1+1))):
            boxes.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1))
    sources = []
    for color,r0,r1,c0,c1 in boxes:
        pts = [(r,c) for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1) if g[r][c] == color]
        if pts:
            pr0=min(r for r,c in pts); pr1=max(r for r,c in pts)
            pc0=min(c for r,c in pts); pc1=max(c for r,c in pts)
            pat=[[g[r][c] == color for c in range(pc0,pc1+1)] for r in range(pr0,pr1+1)]
            sources.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1,pat))
    if not sources:
        return g
    _, sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1,pat = sources[0]
    ph,pw=len(pat),len(pat[0])
    for color,r0,r1,c0,c1 in boxes:
        if (color,r0,r1,c0,c1)==(sources[0][0],sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1):
            continue
        ih,iw=r1-r0-1,c1-c0-1
        if ih < ph and iw < pw:
            for r in range(r0,r1+1):
                for c in range(c0,c1+1): g[r][c]=0
        elif ih >= ph and iw >= pw:
            ro=r0+1+(ih-ph)//2
            co=c0+1+(iw-pw)//2
            for i in range(ph):
                for j in range(pw):
                    if pat[i][j]: g[ro+i][co+j]=color
    return g
'''

exec(compile(program,str(p),'exec'))
